d: Oman—a land where the 'Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque' stands as the heart of the nation's grandeur and identity; where the golden dunes of Sharqiyah Sands stretch endlessly; where the fragrance of frankincense and the taste of 'Kahwa' are woven into the very fabric of the culture; and where the 'Grand Canyon of Arabia' awaits. This is Oman—a place with so much to offer that you simply must discover. So, come along with us on a journey to Oman, right here on Infinity Stream.
